notes:
This is a JavaScript-rendered page that loads property listings dynamically via API. The static HTML contains no listing data. To scrape this site, you need:

1. Use Playwright/Selenium for JavaScript rendering
2. Wait for listings to load (look for elements with class patterns like 'card-property__listing' or similar)
3. The page uses a split-view interface with map and sidebar for results
4. Listings are filtered by listType parameter (For Sale / For Lease)
5. Property types include: Office, Industrial, Multifamily, Retail, Investments, Land, Self-Storage, Food & Cold-Storage

API Investigation Needed:
- Check browser DevTools Network tab for API endpoints
- Likely uses REST API at /api/ or /wp-json/ endpoints
- May return JSON data that can be scraped directly

Alternative approaches:
- Monitor XHR/Fetch requests when page loads
- Look for endpoints like: /api/properties, /wp-json/km/v1/properties, etc.
- May need authentication or API keys

Property search main page: https://kidder.com/property-search/
Results page pattern: https://kidder.com/properties/?listType=For%20Sale&propertyType={type}
